builders.angle: LITERAL. Work BRIEF-r27's list 1 to 4 in order and exactly as written. The card body is ONE component every screen shares: build it once in ui/card.*, then check it on all five screens at both sizes before touching the fan.

THE PRINTED CARD. Treat the rules panel as a printed playing card from the house's own press: a laid-paper or vellum ground with a deckle-soft inner edge, an engraved border in the type's colour, gilt corner brackets, and the rules set in the samples' serif like a page. Make it read as an object you could hold. Then the size-up and the fan.

THE DECK AT 1280 FIRST. Items 2 and 3 are your round: measure every card's name and rules size at 1280 on all five screens and the nine-card fan, and make the card's whole layout serve legibility on the Deck -- name ribbon, type line, rules block, cost coin -- then paint the body (item 1) in the room that layout leaves.
